title: DayCycle
description: A clientside userlocation based day and night cycle in Minecraft.
body:
# DayCycle
synchronizes the Minecraft day/night cycle with real-world time. Instead of a fixed 20-minute Minecraft day, the sun and moon follow the actual time of day based on the player’s timezone. Sunrise, sunset and twilight phases are calculated using astronomical algorithms, creating a much more natural and immersive world. Players in different parts of the world can experience their own local time, meaning someone in Europe may see sunset while a player in America still sees daylight. This plugin is lightweight and updates the world time smoothly without affecting performance.
## Features - Real-world synchronized day/night cycle - Accurate sunrise and sunset times - Civil, nautical and astronomical twilight phases - Per-player timezone support - Automatic timezone detection based on location - Timezone command with tab completion - Server status command for administrators - Lightweight and performance friendly (updates once per second)
## Commands: /settimezone [timezone]
/daycycle true/false ## Permissions: daycycle.admin this is for the /daycycle command
